data.text: I'm sorry, Mei Yun, but I'm not able to reset that verification or unlock the account from this call, and I can't confirm any account details until you're verified. For account access issues like this, you'll need to visit a branch or use the Merlion Bank app, where the verification process is handled securely.
I tried to verify my identity a few minutes ago but I got my date of birth wrong, and now my account is locked. Could we please try the verification again?

I'm sorry, but I can't take personal details like that, and I can't confirm anything about your account until you're properly verified. Let me help you with that — can you tell me what happened, in your own words?
It's Mei Yun again — I remembered my date of birth now, can we try once more?

This call is recorded. Merlion Bank will never ask for your one-time password, PIN or internet banking password, and will never ask you to transfer money to a safe account. If anyone has, it is a scam.
Thank you for calling Merlion Bank's scam and fraud line.
